content: Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, sɑɑ ɡɑɑ sisi yè sɔɔ kon mɑɑ ko Isirelibɑn bwesenu kpuron Yinni, kpɑ be, bɑ n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn tɔmbu.

content.text: Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑburɔ,
nɑ bu nɛn durom sɔ̃ɔsi,
ben be bɑ yɑrɑ tɑbun di,
bɑ wee bu wɛ̃rɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, nɑ bɛɛ nɛn tii sɔ̃ɔsi sɑɑ yellun di.
Nɑ bɛɛ kĩwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ bɛɛ nɛn durom derie.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, kon mɑɑ wure n bɛɛ swĩi,
kpɑ i yɔ̃rɑ.
Kon de i bɛɛn bɑrɑnu so,
kpɑ i yɑri i n yɑɑmɔ be bɑ nuku dobu mɔ̀n suunu sɔɔ,
i ko i mɑɑ resɛmbɑ duure Sɑmɑrin ɡuunɔ,
kpɑ i yen binu wɑ i sɔri.
Sɑɑ yɑ sisi yè sɔɔ wuun kɔ̃sobu bɑ koo nɔɔɡiru suɑ
Efɑrɑimun ɡuuru wɔllun di
bu nɛɛ, i seewo su dɑ Siɔniɔ
mi Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni u wɑ̃ɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
i Yɑkɔbun bweseru tɑki kuo kɑ nuku dobu.
I yɛ̃ɛrio ten sɔ̃ te tɑ sɑ̃ɑ bwesenun wiru.
I nɔɔɡiru suo kpɑ i siɑrɑbun womusu ko.
I nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u win tɔmbu Isireli be bɑ tie fɑɑbɑ mɔ̀.
Wee nɑ kɑ bu wee sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di.
Nɑ bu mɛnnɑmɔ hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛn di.
Tɔn be, bɑ dɑbi.
Be sɔɔ, wɔ̃kobɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ yɛmɔbu kɑ ɡuriɡibu,
kɑ be bɑ yiire bɑ kĩ bu mɑ.
Be wee bɑ wee kɑ swĩi, bɑ mɑn kɑnɑmɔ.
Mɑ nɑ bu kpɑre nɑ kɑ dɔɔ nim bwerɔ
kɑ swɑɑ ye yɑ nɔɔ nɛ sɔɔ,
mi bɑ ǹ sokurɑmɔ.
Domi nɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelin bweserun Bɑɑbɑ.
Mɑ tɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn bii yerumɑ.
Bɛɛ bwese tukunu, i nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio,
kpɑ i yi kpɑrɑ
i kɑ dɑ sere mi n tomɑ.
I nɛɛ, nɛ wi nɑ Isirelibɑn bweseru yɑrinɑsiɑ,
nɑ kon mɑɑ tu mɛnnɑ,
kpɑ n tu kɔ̃su nɡe mɛ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro u rɑ win yɑ̃ɑnu kɔ̃su.
Domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ Yɑkɔbun bweseru yɑkiɑ,
nɑ tu wɔrɑ sɑɑ wi u tu dɑm keren nɔmun di.
Bɑ koo nɑ Siɔnin ɡuuru wɔllɔ,
bɑ n nuku dobu mɔ̀ kɑ kuuki.
Bɑ koo duki nɑ ɑrumɑni ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ bu wɛ̃n sɔ̃.
Yeyɑ, dobi kɑ resɛm kɑ olifi ye bɑ rɑ kɑ ɡum ko, kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ nɛɛ.
Ben bwɛ̃rɑ koo yɛmiɑwɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑru te tɑ nim wɑɑmɔ.
Bɑ ǹ koo mɑɑ wɑhɑlɑ ko.
Wɔndiɑbɑ bɑ koo nuku dobu ko, bɑ n yɑɑmɔ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑ kɑ durɔ tɔkɔnu ko n yɛ̃ɛrimɔ.
Domi kon ben nuku sɑnkirɑnu ɡɔsiɑ nuku dobu,
n bu nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ.
Kpɑ n mɑɑ ben nɔni swɑ̃ɑru ɡɔsiɑ bɔri yɛndu.
Kon de nɛn yɑ̃ku kowobu bu dĩɑ ɡeenu di bu debu,
kpɑ nɛn tɔmbu bu debu nɛn ɑrumɑnin sɔ̃.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Amɛniwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ,
bɑ swĩi ɡɛɛ nɔɔmɔ Rɑmɑɔ.
Yɛ̃ro u sumɔ u weeweenu mɔ̀.
Ase, Rɑsɛliwɑ u sumɔ win bibun sɔ̃.
Mɑ u yinɑmɔ bu nùn suuru kɑnɑ
domi bii be kpurowɑ bɑ ɡu.
Adɑmɑ nɑ nɛɛ,
u mɑrio,
u win nɔni yĩresu woko.
Domi u koo ɑre wɑ ye u win bibu kuɑn sɔ̃.
Bɑ koo wurɑmɑ yibɛrɛbɑn tem di.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, win siɑ yɑ koo wɛ̃rɑ,
domi win bibɑ koo wurɑmɑ ben temɔ.
Nɑ Isirelibɑn nɔɔ nɔɔmɔ bɑ weeweenu mɔ̀, bɑ mɔ̀,
n de bu wurɑmɑ nɛn mi kɑ ɡem.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe nɑɑ buu ɡe ɡɑ ɡen tii kpɑre,
mɑ nɑ bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Domi nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni.
Ye ben lɑɑkɑri yɑ wurɑmɑ, mɑ bɑ tuubɑ kuɑ.
Ye bɑ ben torɑnu ɡiɑ,
mɑ bɑ tukɑ kɑ sekuru
ye bɑ kuɑ sɑɑ ben ɑluwɑɑsirun din sɔ̃.
Isirelin bweseru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe nɛn bii kĩnɑsi.
Mɛyɑ nɑ mɑɑ tu kĩru sɔ̃ɔsi.
Domi nɡe mɛ̀n nɔru nɑ ten ɡɑri mɔ̀,
nɡe mɛyɑ ten kĩru tɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Nɛn bwɛ̃rɑ kun kpunɛ ten sɔ̃.
Kon tu wɔnwɔn bɑkɑru kuɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, i yĩreru koowo bɛɛn swɑɑ sɔɔ
kpɑ i dɑ̃ɑ ɡirɑ.
I swɑɑ ye lɑɑkɑri koowo ye i rɑɑ swĩi.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, i wurɑmɑ bɛɛn wusɔ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ i ko i n kɔ̃ɔre i n yɑɑyɑɑre mɔ̀, bɛɛ nɑɑnɛ sɑribɑ.
Wee nɛ Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ kpɑɑnu kuɑ temɔ.
Tɔn kurɔwɑ u koo durɔ kɑsu.

content: Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni wi u wɔllu kɑ tem mɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ̀ n kɑ Isirelibɑ wurɑmɑ sɑɑ yorun di, ɑmɛniwɑ bɑ koo ɡere Yudɑn tem kpuro sɔɔ bu nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡuu te u ɡɔsɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ domɑru kuo,
mi ɡem mu wɑ̃ɑ.

content: Yudɑbɑ kpuro, kɑ ben ɡbɑɑ wukobu, kɑ be bɑ rɑ yɑɑ sɑbenu kpɑre bɑ koo wurɑ bu sinɑ ben tem wuu mɑrosɔ kɑ mɛn bɑru kpɑɑnɔ.
Domi kon wi nim nɔru ɡɑ mɔ̀ nim wɛ̃, kpɑ win ɡɔ̃ru ɡu yɛmiɑ. Kpɑ n de wi u wɔkɔnu wɔrimɔ ɡɔ̃ɔrun sɔ̃ u di u debu.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Yeremi u dom yɑndɑ, mɑ u mɛɛrɑ u deemɑ win dosu ɡe, ɡɑ dorɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, wee sɑɑ yɑ sisi yè sɔɔ kon de yɑɑ sɑbenu kɑ tɔmbu bu yibu Isireliɔ kɑ Yudɑɔ.
Nɡe mɛ nɑ rɑɑ bu wukurɑ nɑ sururɑ nɡe dɑ̃nu, nɑ bu kɔsukɑ nɑ kɑm koosiɑ nɡe diɑ, nɡe mɛyɑ kon mɑɑ wure n bu seeyɑ n ɡirɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡerumɔ bu nɛɛ,

content.text: bɑɑbɑbɑrɑ bɑ resɛm ɡɔmɑ di,
mɑ ben bibun nɔsu yɑɑyɑ.

content: Adɑmɑ wi u win resɛm ɡɔmɑ di, win nɔɔwɑ ɡɑ koo yɑɑyɑ. Wi u mɑɑ durum kuɑ, wiyɑ u koo ɡbi.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, tɔ̃nu ɡɑnu sisi nì sɔɔ kon kɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ ɑrukɑwɑni kpɑɑ bɔke.
Adɑmɑ yɑ ǹ ko n sɑ̃ɑ yèn bweseru nɑ rɑɑ kɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ bɔkuɑ sɑnɑm mɛ nɑ bu nɔmu nɛnuɑ nɑ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di. Bɑ ǹ ye mɛm nɔɔwɛ, bɑɑ mɛ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben Yinni.

Tɛ̃, ɑrukɑwɑni kpɑɑ ye wee, ye kon kɑ Isirelibɑ bɔke. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, kon de nɛn woodɑbɑ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ben bwisikunu sɔɔ, kpɑ n ye yorusi ben ɡɔ̃rusɔ. Kpɑ nɑ n sɑ̃ɑ ben Yinni, kpɑ be, bɑ n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn tɔmbu.
Domi tɔmbu kpurowɑ bɑ ko n mɑn yɛ̃ sɑɑ bibun di sere kɑ bukurobɔ. Goo kun mɑɑ win winsim ǹ kun mɛ win mɛro bisi ɡoo keu mɔ̀ u kɑ Gusunɔ ɡiɑ. Kon bu ben durum wɔkɑ, kpɑ n ku mɑɑ ye yɑɑyɑ.

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u sɔ̃ɔ kuɑ u kɑ yɑm dɛɛrɑsiɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Mɑ u suru kɑ kperi yi yi, yi kɑ yɑm dɛɛrɑsiɑ wɔ̃kuru.
U rɑ mɑɑ de nim kurenu nu se nim wɔ̃kun di, kpɑ nu wɔki.
Win yĩsirɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wi u wɔllu kɑ tem mɔ.
Wiyɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
tɑkɑ koorɑ yenibɑ kpuro yɑ̀ n koo kpe,
Isirelibɑn bweserɑ koo mɑɑ kpe,
kpɑ tɑ kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
U mɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
mɑ bɑ kpĩɑ bɑ wɔllun kpɑ̃ɑru yĩirɑ bɑ ɡiɑ,
mɑ bɑ duɑ temɔ bɑ mɛn kpɛɛkpɛɛkun ɑsɑnsi ɡiɑ,
sɑɑ yerɑ u koo mɑɑ Isirelin bweseru kpuro yinɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.

content: Wee sɑɑ yɑ sisi yè sɔɔ bɑ koo mɑn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ bu Yerusɑlɛmu bɑni sɑɑ Hɑnɑnɛɛlin di sere n kɑ dɑ wuun ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ ɡɑni ɡɔmburun kɔnnɔ.
Kpɑ bu mɑɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɛmiɑmɑ min di bu yĩire bu kɑ dɑ Gɑrɛbun ɡunɡurɔ, kpɑ bu besirɑ bu dɑ sere Goɑtiɔ.

Wɔwɑ ye kpuro mi bɑ rɑ ɡonu sike kpɑ bu kubɑnu yɑri mi, kɑ ɡbeɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ berɑ mi sere n kɑ dɑ Sedoronin dɑɑrɔ, kɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, mìn di dumi yi rɑ kɑ du, yebɑ kpurowɑ yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔɡiɑ. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ye kɔsukumɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
